0022600135.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic, 4th in the East) are on the road against the Indiana Pacers (2-2, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back, 8th in the East), with both teams on a one-game losing streak. The 76ers won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 105-94 win in Indianapolis on April 10, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), Jabari Walker (out, knee soreness), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (out, knee), Ivica Zubac (out, ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (out, hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (out, hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, and Obi Toppin are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
